title.value: An Intentional Forgetting-Driven Self-Healing Method For Deep Reinforcement Learning Systems
title.justification: The provided title is the exact match from the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: An Intentional Forgetting-Driven Self-Healing Method For Deep Reinforcement Learning Systems

extractions.description: This paper proposes a novel self-healing approach for Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) systems called Dr. DRL. It integrates intentional forgetting into continual learning to enhance adaptability and healing in the face of environmental drifts. The approach focuses on adapting major problem-solving behaviors efficiently by erasing minor ones, described as minor behaviors associated with hypoactive neurons in neural networks. The paper evaluates Dr. DRL's ability to improve healing time, increase the adaptability frontiers, and maintain or improve reward levels in various drifted environments compared to standard continual learning.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is improving the adaptability and healing processes of DRL systems using intentional forgetting, focusing on software engineering aspects, rather than sustainability or ecological impacts.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is increasingly applied in large-scale productions like Netflix and Facebook. As with most data-driven systems, DRL systems can exhibit undesirable behaviors due to environmental drifts, which often occur in constantly-changing production settings.
